gettingStarted.title: Getting Started
gettingStarted.description: Welcome to ToloTanana, the medical records management application for surgical missions.

steps.step1: On first launch, the application asks you to select an edition (medical mission).
steps.step2: Click the refresh icon in the navigation bar to sync and retrieve available editions.
steps.step3: Select the edition you want to work on. All data will be filtered for this mission.
steps.step4: You can switch editions at any time by clicking the refresh icon in the navigation bar.

gettingStarted.tip: The application works offline. Your data is saved locally and automatically synchronized when you are connected.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.description: The dashboard is the home page that provides an overview of the current mission.

features.stats: Global statistics: total patients, scheduled patients, fill rate.
features.performance: Operating room performance: completed operations, average durations.
features.clinical: Clinical analysis: anesthesia types, diagnosis categories, intervention types.

newPatient.title: New Patient
newPatient.description: Create a medical record for a new patient.

steps.step3: Complete the patient identity: last name, first name, date of birth, gender.
steps.step4: Add contact information: phone, address, distance.
steps.step5: Enter vital signs: weight, height, blood pressure, pulse, etc.
steps.step6: Fill in the surgical consultation: diagnosis, intervention type.
steps.step7: If the patient needs surgery, check "To Schedule" and select a day.
steps.step8: Complete the pre-anesthetic consultation: medical history, ASA score, anesthesia type.

newPatient.tip: The record is saved locally immediately, then synchronized with the server in the background.

patientList.title: Patient List
patientList.description: View, search, and manage all patient records for the mission.

features.search: Quick search bar by name, first name, file number, or address.
features.filters: Advanced filters with multiple criteria (contains, equals, starts with, etc.).
features.sort: Column sorting: click a header to sort.
features.tabs: Local / Server tabs to switch between local and remote data.
features.export: CSV export to download the complete list.
features.details: Click on a patient to view their detailed record.
features.edit: Edit a record by clicking the edit button.

team.title: Team Management
team.description: Manage the medical team participating in the mission (surgeons, anesthetists, nurses, etc.).

steps.step1: Access the "Team" page from the navigation bar.
steps.step2: Add a new member by entering their name and specialty.
steps.step3: Assign members to the current edition by clicking "Assign".
steps.step4: Assigned members will be available when entering operation data.

planning.title: Surgical Planning
planning.description: Plan the week's operations with the interactive Kanban board.

features.kanban: Kanban board with an "Unplanned" pool column and 5 day columns (Monday to Friday).
features.dragDrop: Drag and drop patients between columns to assign them to a day.
features.dropdown: Each patient card also has a dropdown menu to change the day (handy on mobile).
features.autoSuggest: "Auto-plan" button: automatically places unplanned patients, prioritizing far-away patients and babies at the beginning of the week.
features.bulkAssign: Select multiple patients in the pool then assign them to a day in one click via the bulk action bar.
features.surgeonAssign: Click the surgeon icon on each card to assign one or more surgeons to the patient.
features.surgeonStats: "Stats" button: summary table showing the number of patients per surgeon per day, with breakdown by diagnosis category.
features.filters: Filter the pool by distance (in town, somewhat far, far), diagnosis category, or age range (babies, children, adults).
features.save: Changes are held in memory until you click "Save" — a counter shows the number of pending changes.

planning.howTo: To add a patient to the planning, create or edit their record, check "Scheduled for mission" and they will appear in the pool. Then use the planning board to assign them to a day.

workflow.title: Operation Workflow
workflow.description: Manage the day's surgical workflow with bulk data entry.

tabs.preOp: Pre-Op: Validate pre-operative calls and patient presence on the day.
tabs.bloc: OR: Record entry/exit times, intervention details, surgical team, prescriptions.
tabs.postOp: Post-Op: Manage recovery room setup and final discharges.

features.bulkActions: Select multiple patients to apply bulk actions.
features.search: Search for a patient by name or file number.
features.filters: Filter by date or status (pending, in OR, post-op, discharged).

sync.title: Offline Mode & Synchronization
sync.description: The application works entirely offline and syncs when a connection is available.

features.offline: All data is stored locally on your device.
features.autoSync: Automatic synchronization runs every 30 seconds when connected.
features.manualSync: Click the sync indicator to force a manual synchronization.
features.status: The indicator at the top of each page shows status: ONLINE, OFFLINE, or SYNCING.
features.conflicts: In case of conflict, the last modification wins (last-write-wins).

sync.tip: You can work without internet. Changes will be sent to the server as soon as the connection is restored.

language.title: Change Language
language.description: The application is available in French and English.

steps.step1: Click the language selector (FR/EN) in the navigation bar.
steps.step2: The interface updates instantly in the chosen language.
steps.step3: Your preference is saved and preserved for your next visits.
